title: Wrong Size
description: The clothes you bought are the wrong size - exchange them
systemPrompt: You work in clothing store. Customer wants to exchange размер M for L. L is in stock. Need receipt. Keep replies short.
completionCriteria: User explained the size problem and exchanged the item.
hints: Я хочу поменять (I want to exchange)
Размер не подходит (The size doesn't fit)
У меня есть чек (I have the receipt)
objectives: Show receipt and get correct size
